versions.content: Describe configuration class of ECU Configuration Param- eters Type: valid Description: When the actual implementation of a BSW module has the freedom to choose the configuration class (pre-compile, link-time, post-build) it SHALL be possible to describe which alternative has been chosen. Rationale: An ECU Configuration Parameter needs to be handled differently depending on its configuration class. Dependencies:  Use Case: The ECU Configuration editor SHALL be able to only allow changes on the post-build time ECU Configuration Parameters. Supporting Material: 
